tei:div.tei:p: (331)'od gsal snying gi thig le las: 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po bzhugs: (332)

'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub pa la: sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum ldan pas/ sbyor ba dngos skyabs 'gro ni: hūm̐: ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'grau ba kun: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar: bcom ldan ye shes sems dpa' la: gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi: de nas byang chub sems bskyed pa: hūm̐: sems can kun la phan slad du: lhag pa'i lha khyod sgrub nas ni: thugs rje rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis: 'gro rnams dbyings su drang bar bya: de nas tshags gsog pa ni: bla ma mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs: sras bcas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: rdul snyed grangs bzhin rnam bsam na: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos dang yid las skyes pa yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: thog med nas bsags sdig ltung kun: gnong ngo 'gyed do so sor bshags: zag bcas zag pa med pa yi: dge ba kun la bdag yi rang : gang 'dul mos ngor 'tshams pa yis: theg gsum rgya (333)mtshos chos 'khor bskor: srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar: 'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge ba'i rtsa ba ji bsags pa: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: de nas nyul la bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsang ba sngags kyi da la 'dir: 'du ba 'os pa ma gtogs pa: lha gzhan rgyu bar mi 'os na: bgegs phran 'byung po smos ci dgos: de bas rang rang gnas su song : rtsa ba'i sngags dang hūm̐ bzhis gzir: de nas mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor ni: stong pa chos nyid nam mkha'i dbyings: ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur: zung 'jug me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong : rang byung khro tshogs rngams pa'i gar: nam mkha' khyab par rab tu gnas: dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: lha dang gnyis med mthong phyag ni: hoḥ sems nyid skye ba med pa'i dbyings: ye nas bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs: gnyis su med pa rig pa'i klong : 'du 'bral med pa ngo mtshar che: bdag gnas byin gyis rlobs pani: hūm̐ḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab:

(334)mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs: shes rab lha mo dbyangs can la: sras bcas rgyal ba thugs dam can: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs rje stobs dang dbang bcu'i dpal: 'jigs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bskyed: mtshan dpe'i gar stabs shigs se shig: tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'u ru ru: mkhyen brtse'i dgongs pa lam se lam: byin rlabs sprin tshogs ya la la: thugs rje char ltar sha ra ra: dam tshig sngags kyi gzhal yas 'dir: byin chen byin phob bdag dbang bskur: dbang chen dbang bskur dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags dang : e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ ja ja: yo byad rdzas rnams brlab pa ni: hūm̐: chos nyid 'gags pa med pa'i rtsal: rten 'byung sgyu ma'i rol mo ni: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i: mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ar+ghaṃ pad+yaṃ sogs nas/ ma hā pañca amṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling ta swā hā: des ni sbyor ba'i chos rjogs so: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sa ma ti: (335)oṃ dag dang ma dag chos po cog: ye nas dag mnyam chen pa'i ngang : 'gags med snying rje chen po nyid: nam mkha' mnyam par kun la brdal: stong pa nyid dang snying rje che: zug 'jug rig pa chos sku'i gdangs: rtsal snang yi ge dhīḥru shar: rtsal dang rtsal las 'phro ba'i tshul: khams lnga rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: 'byung ba lnga yi sa bon chad: e yid mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: yaṃ rdo rje rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'khrigs: khaṃ gsal dag chu yi dkyil 'khor brten: laṃ de steng rin chen sa gzhi'i dbus: rin chen lhun po grub bzhi brdal: kha khyer rdo rje me ris gtams: tshogs brgyad yul dbang rnam shes brgyad: gnas dag dur khrod gnas brgyad na: lha brgyad klu brgyad ma mo brgyad: me brgyad chu brgyad ljon shing brgyad: grub pa chen po rig 'jin brgyad: dur khrod rgyan gyis mjes pa'i dus: yul snang dag pas pad+ma ni:

ge sar 'dab steng (336)mjes pa yi/ ge sar nyi ma'i gdan gyi dbus: phung lnga rnam par dag pa yi: 'khor lo rin chen rtsibs bzhi'i dbus: bh+rūm̐: rang snang rgyan rdzogs gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab brgyad: ye shes lnga yi brtsegs pa'i steng : pha gu bre dang gdung mas mjes: dral dang dral phyams rin chen thogs: 'dod rnam sgo dang sgo rdzogs kyi: rnam byang 'bras bu'i rta bab brgyad: rin chen nor bu'i tog gis spras: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rgyan gyis bskor: mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pho brang dbus: rin chen seng ge pad+ma'i steng : nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyis dbus: rig pa yi ge dhīḥdamar babs: 'od dang 'od zer 'bar ba yis: sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen rtse bsdus: sems can kun gyidwangs ma 'phrog: yongs gyur mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi gser gyi mdog: phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis: shes rab ral gri glegs bam bsnams: 'og mas thabs shes mda' gzhu 'chang : (337)dbu skra gnag snum zur phud brgyan: 'jum dang dgyes pa'i mdangs mnga' ba: spyan zung 'khor 'das gnyis la gzigs: thabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: rin chen sna tshogs dar gyis brgyan: mtshan gyi 'dab steng rgyas pa la: dpe byad ge sar mjes pas rgyan: mthong bas yid 'phrog 'jam pa'i dbyangs: snang stong gnyis med gsal ba'i sang : shes rab lha mo dbyangs can ma: ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa'i mdangs: bcu drug lo lon gzhon nu'i sku: phyag gnyis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag mtshan dri za'i gling bu bsgreng : zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung bzhugs: cha lugs rgyan rnams yab dang mtshungs: 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi: mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun dang : byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang : rang rgyal 'phags pa chen po'i tshogs: mgon po khyed kyi rol mo ste: gsal la ma 'dres lhun gyis grub: mi zad rgyan gyi ngo bor rdzogs:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: (338)oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ dbyings nas ye shes dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drangs: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rgya nag yul: gnas kyi mchog gyur de'u shan: sprul pa'i zhing khams me tog bkod: gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga nas: bla ma 'jam dbyangs gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i skyed tshal na: ngag gi lha mo gshegs su gsol: ma nges zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rgyal ba sras bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan mañju shrī ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: dam ye ro gcig gsol ba ni: hūm̐: lha dang snang ba chos nyid gsum: ye nas de bzhin nyid du gcig: bzhugs su gsol ba ma dmigs kyang : kun rdzob mos ngor bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wam: gnyis med 'phrul dga'i brda phyag ni: hoḥ lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs: rgyal kun bskyed yum dbyangs can ma: dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: rab tu gus pas (339)phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tī ja ho: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod 'bul ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgon po 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas la: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: dri gtsang bcud ldan mchod yon 'bul: yan lag brgyad ldan zhabs bsil 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ ho: bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas la: kha dog dbyings mjes me tog 'bul: dri bsung kun zhim bdug spos 'bul: dri med 'od gsal mar me 'bul: rab bzhil snyogs med dri chab 'bul: ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas 'bul: sgra snyan kun ldan rol mo 'bul: puṣ+pe dhup+pe a lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mgon po 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang stong sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang : mi shig na dā chos nyid sgra: 'pho med zag bral dri chab dang : ting 'jin zag med ro mchog dang :

rab 'bar bde stong dga' bzhi'i rog: ye shes rol mo chos nyid chos: 'bul lo (340)dgyes bzhes dngos grub stsol: rū pa shab+ta gan+dhe ra pa ar+she dharmā dha tu puts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐: shes rab dbyings las rnam par shar: ye shes sgyu ma'i lha mo'i tshogs: dga' ba bcu drug mngon du ston: phyag rgya gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ma hā mu tra pūts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos: gdod nas rang byung bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca amri ta la khā hi: hūm̐: khams gsum rtsa ba 'dod chags khrag: dmar chen rak+ta'i rba rlabs las: 'dod yon lha mo'i zer phreng 'khrigs: mgon po 'jam dbyangs tshogs la 'bul: ye shes thug rjes chags par mjod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: ye nas rang byung gtor ma mchog: phyi nang snod bcud gtor ma sbyar: dam tshig dpa' bo'i rlan gyis sbran: mgon po 'jam dbyangs tshogs la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog (341)gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling ta khā hi: chos nyid don gyi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gdod nas rang byung 'jam pa'i dbyangs: spros bral chos nyid nam mkha'i ngang : don dam ye shes sems dpa'i sku: chos sku mtshan ma med la 'dud: mtshan dang dpe byad yon tan 'bar: nges pa lnga ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs: kha sbyor bde stong ye nas shar: longs sku dmigs pa med la 'dud: gang la gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul 'chang : ma nges sprul pa'i cho 'phrul ston: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon mchog: sprul sku 'gags pa med la 'dud: shes rab dbyings las rol pa yi: ye shes lha mo dbyangs can ma: zung 'jug sgyu 'phru drwa ba'i ngang : yab yum sras dang btsun mor bcas: 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings la 'dud: gsang ba thugs dam rgyud bskul ni: hūm̐: thugs kar skye ba med pa'i dbyings:

rang byung ye shes sems dpa' nyid: gsal ba'i thugs mchog 'od kyi klong : pad+ma zla steng dhīḥyig mthar: (342)ma bcos rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: 'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin dbang bsdu: yang 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: tshur 'dus gzhi 'jin dhīḥl thim: bkrag mdangs cher rgyas shes rab dang : ye shes snang ba rgyas par bsam: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ des na dngos gzhi'i chos rjogs so: rjes rim tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bza' bca' btung ba mchog gi ro: bdud rtsi ja gad dpa' bos bran: ye shes longs spyod sgrub pa'i rdzas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing : me tog bkod pa'i pho brang nas: bla ma mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs: yab yum sras bcas tshogs la gshegs: badz+ra sa mā jaḥ hūm̐: mgon po dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang : 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes bzhes mkhyen pa'i dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra hoḥ hūm̐: mgon khyod (343)brtse bas bdag la dgongs: thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar: mi shes sdig pa gang bgyis pa: tshogs kyi 'khor los bshags par bgyi: badz+ra sa ma ya shud dhe āḥ hūm̐: 'jam dpal rnon po ral gri yis: bsad pas sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob: de phyir mnga' bdag tu tra'i tshogs: bdag med rtogs pa'i dbyings su sgrol: rū tra ma ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: ma rtogs bsgral ba'i snyigs ma'i tshogs: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'jam dbyangs 'khor bcas tshogs la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog gi dngos grub rtsol: ma hā ha la kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran la: gnas pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: lhag brgyud tshogs rnams lhag la rol: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sol: u tsaṣ+ṭi ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs:

chos kyi dbyings nas (344)skur bzhengs la: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i stobs bskyed la: snyigs dus rgud pa'i mun pa sol: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa spor: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: de nas chad tho bsgrags pa na: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: kun bzang blo ldan dpa' bo dang : rig 'jin gter 'don bla ma yis: spyan sngar khas blangs dam can rnams: 'dir gshegs dpal gyi gtor ma longs: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: o āḥhūm̐: bde skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: glu len gar stabs khyugs se khyug: bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di longs la: mtha' dmag rgya 'dre'i sgo 'phrang chod: sa ma ya: de nas dam sri mnan pa ni: hūm̐: log par 'dren pa'i dam sri kun: mnan no ri rab 'go tu mnan: steng du rdo rje'i bro brdung pas: nam yang sdang bar med par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: s+t+wam bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: hoḥ bla ma 'jam dbyangs lha tshogs dgongs: bskyed rdzogs (345)ma dag zur nyams chags: nongs shing 'gal ba bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs brjod: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: lha khyod sgrub pa'i dam tshig thim: mi gnas rdo rje'i gnas gsum nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: zab mo spobs pa'i gter brgyad kyis: mkhyen brtse yi shes dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags dang : kā ya wāk+ka tsirta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de nas lha snang bsdu ba ni: hoḥ ye shes dbyings las sprul pa yi: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i snang cha kun: zung 'jug rig pa'i dbyings su yal: slar yang snang grags rol pa kun: ye nas ye shes ral par shar: a a a: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: rig pa dbyings las shar ba'i sku: rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyings: yab yum sras 'khor bka' sdod tshogs: bkra shis dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: bla ma rnasam kyi bkra shis shog:

mchog thun dngos (346)grub stsol ba'i bdag: yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog: phrin las lhun grub mnga' dbang bsgyur: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog: de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni: 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge rtsa kun: mar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang 'jam dpal dpa' bo yis: gsang gsum rdo rje mngon gyur nas: kun mkhyen rgyal ba nyid thob shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di ni dbon rig 'jin rgya mtshos a ra pa tsa du phyur gcig gis khas blangs ni maṇ+ḍal phul ba la brten: sngags btsun las 'brel gyi bris pa dge'o/// /
